title: Backend Developer Intern
raw_text: Backend Developer Intern role focused on building REST APIs for an internal recruitment platform. The candidate should know Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, basic SQL, API design, and Git. Docker and AWS are nice to have.
responsibilities: Build and maintain REST API endpoints
Collaborate with frontend developers on API contracts
requirements: FastAPI or similar Python web framework
education_requirement: Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent self-study background

title: Frontend Engineer Junior
raw_text: Frontend Engineer Junior role for a SaaS recruitment dashboard. The candidate should be comfortable with TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, component-based UI, form handling, and API integration. UI/UX sense and testing are preferred.
responsibilities: Integrate frontend screens with REST APIs
Improve UI consistency and interaction states

title: AI Data Intern
raw_text: AI Data Intern role supporting dataset preparation and baseline model evaluation. The candidate should know Python, pandas, data cleaning, scikit-learn basics, and basic NLP concepts. Sentence Transformers experience is a bonus.
education_requirement: Current student or fresh graduate in IT, Data Science, AI, or related field

title: DevOps Engineer Junior
raw_text: DevOps Engineer Junior role focused on deployment automation and developer workflow. Required skills include Linux, Docker, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, shell scripting, and monitoring basics. AWS and Terraform are preferred.
education_requirement: Related technical background or equivalent practical experience

title: Full-stack RMS Engineer
raw_text: Full-stack RMS Engineer role for an AI recruitment management system. The candidate should work across Next.js, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, API integration, and recruitment workflows. CV parsing or AI scoring experience is preferred.
responsibilities: Integrate frontend flows with AI service APIs
Design data flows for candidates, resumes, job descriptions, applications, and evaluations
Improve maintainability across frontend and backend service boundaries
education_requirement: Software Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent project/work experience
